description: This file is a device driver implementation for Nuvoton Numaker GPIO in the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, control, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin direction, pull-up/down, and multi-function settings.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_port_get_raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw GPIO port input data.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets GPIO port output data with a mask.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits in GPIO port output.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin interrupt mode and trigger.

methods.name: gpio_numaker_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO port interrupts.
